title: AI Employees That Actually Remember Working Here
pitch: Paperclip lets you hire a team of AI agents, give them a business goal, and manage them like a task manager — but every agent still starts each task with a blank slate, re-learning the company's quirks, client preferences, and past mistakes from scratch. Hindsight is a memory layer built specifically to make agents learn over time instead of just recalling chat history. Wire Hindsight into each Paperclip 'employee' and the org stops resetting: the marketing agent remembers which pitches flopped last quarter, the engineer agent remembers this client's coding conventions, and onboarding a new agent to an existing team takes minutes instead of re-explaining everything. The buyer is the same solo founder or small agency already running a Paperclip agent org who is tired of agents making the same mistakes every sprint.
why_now: Both projects are trending on the same day and solve adjacent gaps in the same emerging category — managed AI agent teams — with neither yet shipping the other's piece.
